issues.description: Plan Line 26 defines first execution as getItem returning null OR an empty string ('빈 문자열') and directly overwrites it with an empty list ('이 경우 바로 빈 목록으로 덮어쓴다'). However, a present empty string is stored data that is malformed JSON, not an absent key. Overwriting it contradicts Plan Line 17 ('데이터 손상이면 쓰기를 막고 임의 초기화/덮어쓰기하지 않는다') and REQ-06.
issues.suggestedDirection: Distinguish absent (null) from present empty string (''). Restrict initial empty list creation to null only, and treat a present empty string as corrupted data that blocks writes to protect existing stored data.

decision.feedback:
issue-3a4c17d008787809: Plan Line 26 defines first execution as getItem returning null OR an empty string ('빈 문자열') and directly overwrites it with an empty list ('이 경우 바로 빈 목록으로 덮어쓴다'). However, a present empty string is stored data that is malformed JSON, not an absent key. Overwriting it contradicts Plan Line 17 ('데이터 손상이면 쓰기를 막고 임의 초기화/덮어쓰기하지 않는다') and REQ-06. — Distinguish absent (null) from present empty string (''). Restrict initial empty list creation to null only, and treat a present empty string as corrupted data that blocks writes to protect existing stored data.
issue-storage-present_empty: present_empty: Line 26 treats an empty string as a first run and directly overwrites it with an empty list, which contradicts Line 17 and REQ-06 data preservation rules against overwriting corrupted data without explicit authorization. 기존 JSON 값을 초기화/덮어쓰는 복구에 대한 승인 Scope 근거가 없습니다. — 원본 보존·쓰기 차단으로 보완하거나, 명시적으로 허용된 복구 정책의 승인 Scope 근거를 확인하십시오.
